matching: One-to-one Hungarian assignment maximizing source-raster mask IoU between final PyTorch and ONNX polygon instances, independent of query order and generated IDs

box_definition: Axis-aligned bounds left/top/right/bottom of returned production polygon in source pixel-edge coordinates, not unused normalized decoder boxes
